issue_title: Home page performance below 85 — TBT regression (115 ms → 239 ms)
issue_body:
## Home page performance regression

**Audit date:** 2026-11-15T15:40:54.324Z
**Page:** `/`

### Scores
| Metric | Previous | Current | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Performance | 86 | 81 | **−5** (below 85 threshold) |
| TBT | 115 ms | 238.7 ms | **+123.7 ms** |
| LCP | 3709 ms | 3845 ms | +136 ms |
| CLS | 0.015 | 0.015 | stable |

### Impact
Performance has fallen below the 85 alert threshold. TBT has more than doubled, indicating a main-thread blocking regression, likely a newly added or un-deferred JS bundle.

### Suggested fix
1. Run a Lighthouse trace locally to identify the longest tasks.
2. Defer or async-load any non-critical scripts (analytics, particles, animations).
3. Consider code-splitting heavy demo/interactive modules so they load only on project pages.

### Also noted (below 85, within single-run jitter but worth watching)
- `/projects/note-structurer` performance: 84 → 81
- `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` performance: 82 → 80
